description: Parity: the capture panel fits its backlinks. With the subject's 3 backlinks (graph-backlinks.json), and again with 4 after graph-backlinks-newer.json is merged, the last backlink row lies inside the backlinks' scroll box and the box inside the window, so no row is cut off.
requirement: P2-capture-fit (GPUI Phase 2b parity, Tauri ee80e70:dist/panel.js fitWindow/desiredHeight for the capture view)
notes: Measured layout (views/layout.rs): view.layout.last_backlink (the last row), view.layout.backlinks_box (the list's scroll box) and view.layout.viewport, in window points from one frame, compared with {"path": ...} operands.
Tauri sized the window to the capture view's content (scrollHeight). At a fixed 140 pt the third backlink row is cut by the panel's bottom padding and later rows scroll out of sight.
Must fail before the fix (on the instrumentation commit) at '3 backlinks: the last row is fully visible'.

steps.name: 3 backlinks: the last row is fully visible
3 backlinks: the panel is on its display
4 backlinks: the last row is fully visible
4 backlinks: the panel is on its display
